page.overview:
Who is Yukiri Haruna?

Yukiri Haruna is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower., Yukiri Haruna|Yukiri}} During the White Tower Schism, Yukiri voted to depose Siuan Sanche and replace her with Elaida a'Roihan, although she soon came to regret the decision in light of Elaida's growing incompetence.

Yukiri and a group of other Sitters formed the Black Ajah Hunters after Elaida grew deeply suspicious of Alviarin Freidhen, and were able to independently confirm the existence of the Black Ajah. She eventually began to work with Egwene al'Vere when she was held in the White Tower and reduced to a novice, and remains one of most senior sisters in the Tower.

Yukiri has green eyes and a small frame and is described as 5 feet tall, slight and slender. Egwene al'Vere thinks she is one of the shortest women she has ever met.

Despite her lack of height, she manages to comport herself as regally as any Queen. When frustrated, however, she can relapse into the farmer's accent of her youth. During negotiations and mediations she has been known to use her native accent as a way to unbalance the other parties as the contrast can leave them confused.
